query:
UPDATE customers
            SET billing_contact_id = (
                    SELECT other.id
                    FROM customer_contacts other
                    WHERE other.customer_id = customers.id AND other.deleted_at IS NULL
                    ORDER BY other.is_primary DESC, other.created_at ASC
                    LIMIT 1
                ),
                updated_at = $2
            WHERE billing_contact_id = $1
